Technical Manual

## What this page explains

We use Stata to control the production of public release datasets. Using these public release datasets, we then use Stata for report production, and Quarto for all web production, such as dashboards and online data tables. Use this page to understand the common controls before opening a product-specific procedure.

## System at a glance

```{mermaid}
flowchart TB
    A["Authorised source data"] --> B["Private preparation and analysis"]
    B --> C["Automated checks and human review"]
    C --> D["Approval of the exact candidate"]
    D --> E["Controlled analytical publication"]
    E --> F["Local Quarto render and review"]
    F --> G["GitHub deployment"]
```

Each box is a distinct stage. Each arrow shows the controlled move to the next stage. A successful calculation is not approval. Analytical publication does not deploy the website, and a successful local Quarto render does not make a change live.

## Choose the correct workflow

| Workflow | Main input | Controlled result |
|--|---|---|
| [CVD event data release](cvd-events/overview.qmd) | Authorised cumulative CVD REDCap data release and approved retained inputs | Approved public CVD event metric package and website data copy |
| [CVD mortality data release](mortality/overview.qmd) | Authorised cumulative mortality REDCap data release and approved reference inputs | Approved public CVD mortality metric package and website data copy |
| [Rolling three-month update](reporting/rolling-update.qmd) | Exact approved event and mortality data-release CSVs | Dated and versioned online update package |
| [Annual CVD report](reporting/annual-report.qmd) | Approved data releases and year-specific analyst files | Approved annual PDF, companion Public Health Update and landing pages |
| [One-off CVD report](reporting/one-off-report.qmd) | Finished analyst PDF | Approved report PDF and landing-page package |

The CVD event and mortality data-release workflows remain separate. Dashboards, public tables and downloads reuse their approved public metric files; they do not rerun or redefine the analysis.

## Refresh website products that use approved outputs

A data-package release or report publication also prompts updates to several website products. These are not separate workflows, and they occur whener a new data release package arrive is published to the Info-Hub `site/` location. 

| Website product | Approved input | Guide |
|--|---|---|
| CVD dashboards | Current approved CVD event or mortality files | [Refresh the CVD dashboards](reporting/dashboard-regeneration.qmd) |
| CVD tables | Current approved CVD event and mortality files | [Refresh the CVD tables](reporting/tabulation-regeneration.qmd) |
| Downloads page | Approved catalogue records and ZIP packages | [Rebuild the Downloads page](reporting/downloads-page-regeneration.qmd) |
| Report listings | Published report landing-page metadata | [Rebuild the report listings](reporting/report-listings-regeneration.qmd) |

These procedures do not prepare source data, calculate surveillance measures or approve and publish an analytical package. The [reporting and presentation overview](reporting/overview.qmd) brings all reporting and refresh procedures together.

## Follow the common workflow control pattern

1. Build analytical files and review candidates in the private workspace.
2. Run the automated checks and complete the required human analytical and disclosure review.
3. If a problem is found, correct the source data, configuration, reference file or version-controlled code and rerun from the earliest affected step.
4. An authorised **BNR Lead or BNR Analyst** approves the exact reviewed candidate through its Stata approval action.
5. Run the separate Stata publication action, which verifies the approval and copies only the files listed in the approved manifest.
6. Render and inspect the Info-Hub locally.
7. Merge the reviewed website change into `main` through a GitHub pull request, allow GitHub Actions to deploy it and check the live website.

## Know the responsibilities

| Role or action | Responsibility |
|---|----|
| **BNR Analyst** | Runs the analytical workflow and reviews the results and supporting evidence. |
| **BNR Lead** | Holds operational and governance responsibility. |
| **Authorised BNR Lead or BNR Analyst** | Records approval of the exact analytical package. |
| **BNR Developer** | Maintains the version-controlled analytical and publication implementation; this role does not replace analytical approval. |
| **Publisher** | Runs the controlled publication action only after approval has been recorded. |

One authorised person may perform more than one action where BNR governance permits, but preparation, review, approval, analytical publication and website deployment remain separate recorded actions.
